business_summary: JAPAN Creative Platform Group Co., Ltd. engages in the creative services business in Japan. The company involved in commercial, publication, and special printing; web production; multimedia planning and production, surface treatment, and other related business; provision of supplement and promotional products; planning, manufacturing, and sale of packaging materials; offset and value-added printing; metal processing mold metal printing; surface processing; sign display; planning and production of sp tool; media management; planning and manufacturing of package fixtures; print processing, binding, shipping, management, and other related services; binding of magazines, books, textbooks, weekly magazines, catalogs, calendars, etc.; foil stamping relief plates and pad printing plates manufacturing; and operates an advertising agency. It also produces 3DCG/digital, Web/interactive, and 2D/3D digital content; provides website construction and content development; sales promotion consulting; production; art printing; gallery management; brand strategy planning, visual production, and consulting; model management, casting, promotion; magazine/book publishing/web media/content marketing; photo studio management; multilingual translation, document creation and content management; editing; sales promotion; sells educational materials and ICT equipment; communication development; planning and production of cg and in-house content services; designs, manufactures, and sells digital audio equipment, as well as plans, designs, and constructs video and audio systems. In addition, the company offers stationery and capsule toys, cosmetic pouches and bags for adult women, paper stationery, character figurines, chocolate, lucky charms and gifts, and novelty. Further, it engages in bookbinding business. The company was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
